title: backlog.py report ID prints a returned worker's outcome in one call: its session result, the branch's commits and diffstat, and the gates on the branch
goal: report ID prints the scratch result.json's subtype, num_turns, total_cost_usd and session_id with the tail of its result text, then the commits of work/ID ahead of origin/main with the diffstat and each gate of the item on that branch with its id, options and recommendation; an item with no result.json or no work branch prints which one is missing and exits 1, and report writes nothing; report prints a warning line for each line of the result text that says a gate was not recorded; dispatch's closing output ends with report's first line and its warning lines

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
def item(i,**k):
 d=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);d.update(k)
 (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n")
def commit():g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
def run(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
item("ST-aaaaaaaa",gates=[{"id":"g1","kind":"provisional","question":"q","options":["a","b"],"recommendation":"b"}]);commit();g("update-ref","refs/remotes/origin/main","HEAD")
g("checkout","-q","-b","work/ST-aaaaaaaa");(r/"x.txt").write_text("w");g("add","-A")
g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","worker change");g("checkout","-q","-")
sc=r/"_cache"/"scratch"/"ST-aaaaaaaa";sc.mkdir(parents=True)
(sc/"result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"subtype":"success","num_turns":12,"total_cost_usd":0.5,"session_id":"sess-1","result":"all done"}))
a=run("report","ST-aaaaaaaa");item("ST-bbbbbbbb");commit();b=run("report","ST-bbbbbbbb")
print(a.returncode,a.stdout[-300:],a.stderr[-200:],b.returncode,b.stdout[-200:],b.stderr[-200:])
ok=a.returncode==0 and all(w in a.stdout for w in ("12","0.5","sess-1","all done","worker change","g1"))
sys.exit(0 if ok and b.returncode==1 and "result.json" in b.stdout+b.stderr else 1)

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: in 7 days the 72 orchestrating sessions made 383 turns whose only call parsed a worker's result.json (540 result.json reads in 57 sessions overall), 143 turns that tailed a dispatch log and 421 turns of git log, diff or show on work/ID; together 947 of 13,429 turns (7.1%, 156M cache-read tokens). The sequences recur: dispatch, wait on the pid, read the result 48 times; read the result, git show the item file, answer 39 times. One call leaves about a quarter of that: about 700 turns and about 35 USD a week (estimate). Today dispatch's closing output holds the exit line and rows_line only (bl_dispatch.py:1030-1033 and :1165), and the sprint skill and kb/_self/backlog.md prescribe the manual read. Also wanted, not read by the planted check: dispatch's closing output ends with the first two lines of the report, a changed protected path that needs stage-back is flagged, and kb_backlog serves report read-only (BACKLOG_COMMANDS; name _tools/test_redact.py). Parked parts of this: ST-24aav43q (dispatch's return warns on an unrecorded choice) and ST-yyup6d62 (cost from result.json by hand). Lane: parked sprint-orchestration class, EP-gzr4mmkm.
